samples.question: At START, read the top-to-bottom order of the circle, square, and triangle. Follow the single dark route from START to FINISH. In route order, each red checkpoint applies a swap: one red bead swaps the top and middle slots; two red beads swap the middle and bottom slots. After all five swaps, which color tag at FINISH is beside the slot containing the circle? Answer amber, cyan, or violet.
